It’s reasonable to want to hang out with friends your age without unwanted intrusions. 2. **Your Space, Your Rules** – Your home is your space, and you have every right to decide who you’re comfortable inviting in. If you didn’t know he was coming, it’s fair to ask before committing. 3. **The Dad’s Behavior Is Problematic** – His comments about women and his over-involvement in your social circle cross a line. If your girlfriend was uncomfortable, that’s a red flag. You’re not obligated to tolerate that. 4. **You’re Not the Problem** – His friends’ defense of him ("he’s just trying to live his youth") doesn’t excuse his behavior. If he can’t respect that, he’s not really a friend—just a guy who’s trying to live vicariously through his son. **1/10—you’re doing the right thing.** *(And if your girlfriend is still uncomfortable, that’s another conversation—maybe she shouldn’t be around him at all.)*
